title: From freely falling frames to the Lorentz gauge-symmetry group and a Hamiltonian composite theory of gravitation
summary: The concept of freely falling frames suggests that gravity exhibits a local Lorentz gauge symmetry and requires a background Minkowski reference frame. The gauge vector fields of a Yang-Mills-type theory can be constructed from the transformations to these local freely falling frames, thereby leading to a composite theory of gravity. We propose coordinate conditions under which an exact black-hole solution can be obtained.
